name: Nation Employment
summary: MDW / helper agency — interview process, SIP booking, insurance floors, and MOM compliance support.
body: Helper agencies should be transparent on fees, replacement policies, and training. You remain the employer under MOM rules — understand levy concession traps for foreign kids, Settling-In Programme within seven days for first-time helpers, enhanced medical insurance (≥S$60k inpatient), personal accident cover, and six-monthly medicals before the helper arrives. Compare total cost against Comfort Employment and DIY transfer routes using the MDW hiring guide.
whenToEngage: Need agency support for SIP + six-monthly medicals
Comparing replacement policy vs Comfort / DIY
Levy concession traps for foreign kids unclear
